lectures.title: Who else is in the room? Van Eyck's Arnolfini Portrait
Where do you have to stand? Holbein's The Ambassadors
Where is the hero? Bruegel's Fall of Icarus
Which one is Matthew? Caravaggio's Calling of Saint Matthew
Who is the painter painting? Velázquez's Las Meninas
Why pull back a curtain? Vermeer's The Art of Painting
Who is watching whom? Fragonard's The Swing
Why show a man from behind? Friedrich's Wanderer above the Sea of Fog
Why does the street walk toward us? Caillebotte's Paris Street; Rainy Day
Can this mirror be right? Manet's A Bar at the Folies-Bergère

quiz.question: A photographer wants one shot of a bride that shows the guests watching, without turning the camera. What would van Eyck do?
choices: Shoot from far back
Hang a mirror behind the bride
Ask the bride to look at the guests
Write the guests' names on the wall

quiz.question: A photographer wants a portrait of a tech billionaire that quietly says success doesn't last. Which choice follows Holbein's method?
choices: A caption: you will die
A detail that only shows from one angle
A gloomy face
A skull on his desk

quiz.question: A painter wants to show the cost of a war the way Bruegel shows Icarus. Which picture follows his method?
choices: A tiny burning village alone in an empty landscape
A family at supper while, far off, a village burns
Villagers at supper, all turning to stare at a distant fire
A weeping general, close up

quiz.question: A poster wants every passer-by to wonder: does this mean me? Which design follows Caravaggio?
choices: A finger aimed straight out at you
A spotlight on one named man
A finger aimed into a crowd, picking no one clearly
No gesture, just the words

quiz.question: A photographer wants a wedding photo that puts the viewer in the couple's place. Which follows Velázquez?
choices: The couple in the centre, smiling at the lens
The couple from behind, facing the guests
Guests look into the lens; the couple only as a reflection
Guests look into the lens; the couple among them, back to us

quiz.question: A film director wants viewers to feel they are secretly watching a pianist practise. Which shot follows Vermeer?
choices: Her face, eyes on the lens
Over her shoulder, as she glances back
Through a half-open door, behind her
A full concert hall, from the stalls

quiz.question: A film director wants the audience to feel part of an affair. Which shot follows Fragonard's method?
choices: We see the lover hiding; the chatting spouse can't
We watch it all through the unaware spouse's eyes
The lovers kiss alone, with no one else near
The spouse finds them, and the secret is out

quiz.question: A travel ad wants viewers to imagine themselves on a mountain top. Which shot follows Friedrich?
choices: A hiker grinning at the camera
The empty view, nobody in it
Hiker's back to us, looking out
A hiker's face in close-up

quiz.question: A film director wants the audience to feel they are inside a busy market crowd. Which shot follows Caillebotte?
choices: From a rooftop, the whole market below
A long lens from across the street
Handheld among the stalls, at head height
Every shopper posed neatly in frame

quiz.question: A filmmaker wants viewers to feel they are a character in the scene, as Manet does. Which shot follows his method?
choices: A wide shot of the whole room
The actor stares straight into the lens
A reflection shows someone standing where the camera is
A close-up of the actor's tears
